'''S. K. Singh''' was a professor of mathematics from [[University of Missouri]] - [[Kansas City, Missouri|Kansas City]]. He received his Ph.D. on the Entire and [[Meromorphic function]]s from [[Aligarh Muslim University]] in 1953. His advisor was [[S. M. Shah]]. Singh was one of the founder fathers and Head of the Department of Mathematics, [[Karnataka University]], [[Dharwar]].<ref>[http://www.kud.ernet.in/PG_Deparments/Science_Departments/Mathamatics/maths.htm Karnataka University] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080613160628/http://www.kud.ernet.in/PG_Deparments/Science_Departments/Mathamatics/maths.htm |date=2008-06-13 }}</ref>
